title: Resume Builder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Creates and formats a professional resume from the student's experience. The Resume Builder creates and formats a professional resume. It takes the student's education, experience, projects, and skills, arranges them in a clean reverse-chronological layout with strong action verbs, and tailors the emphasis for the target role. The result reads like a professional wrote it — because the structure is professional, filled with the student's real content.
capabilities: Tailor emphasis for the target role
Format cleanly for ATS and humans
